reviews.comment: Absolute great guy, type of man you'd trust taking your car for a spin or with your bank account information, the class in general is just not needed. Simm's could be better used elsewhere. You don't need to study just show up every class and listen. This isn't a Simm's problem its TAMU money grubbing on courses that don't matter sadly.

reviews.comment: If you need the Cosc222 credit, just show up to large group lecture and small group lecture and do the packbacks and journal entries. Your grade is basically entirely off those with no exams, purely attendance and participation/no more than an hour of homework per week. Simms is a great professor too, very helpful and caring.

This Class is so boring but an easy A if you review the slide show before each exam. I will finish with a B only because the exams were always the same day as Boldt's assignments were due. Simms is a nice guy but just very boring. Looking around every lecture there were always people asleep.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Simms means well, but he is very hard to listen to. He warned us in class presentations to not bore people with long rambling PowerPoints but he did that almost daily. I'm not sure Hanks is any better but Simms is a little boring. Not a hard class though.

reviews.comment: Not sure where the amazing reviews come from but he his decent at best. pretty much just reads off a power point for an hour and then might give you a pop quiz. Nothing about him is amazing but nothing is bad. It is just kind of boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I'm not the best test taker, so I ended up with a C, but I felt like I learned more in this class than in any others so far in the Construction Science program.

reviews.comment: Prof. Simms is such an amazing professor, you will learn a lot from him. His lectures are amazing and always teaches with a passion. 10/10 recommend!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Respected

reviews.comment: Professor Simms is an incredible professor. He structures his lectures in a way that promotes class interaction and always brings samples of the material we are learning about. His lectures are unequivocal and concise, and his pop quizzes are easy and straightforward. If you need to take COSC 253 Professor Simms is an amazing choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I have only good things to say about Simms. His lectures are attention grabbing! His quizzes/tests are very fair. He tells you exactly what to read/watch for tests through guided notes and study guides, and his quizzes are verbatim his class lectures. As long as you attend all lectures and take diligent notes, you will walk away with a good grade!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Caring

reviews.comment: Simms is one of the best professors I have had, he is very respectful to his students. the class is a lot of lectures but he makes them easy to understand and to pay attention along. Attend every class if you want to pass his class the tests are over the lectures that he posts.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Respected

reviews.comment: I had him for COSC 222, and it was a very easy class.  Attendance was mandatory, but assignments were simple and grading was easy.  No phones or earbuds allowed in class!

Simms lectures very well and will use models/illustrations on the board to explain the concept. He will bring small pieces of construction hardware/materials and pass them around. He does pop quizzes which are open notes and his tests are slightly difficult, so study. No hw but he suggests that we read the textbook, which I and others never did.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Respected--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Simms is a good professor and teaches you a lot of really good things. He does have a lot of pop quizzes, which tend to be every week so be aware of that, you really have to go to class. He also asks very specific questions on the tests, that he only will mention in lecture. The only hw is to "read the textbook" but i never did and did fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Simms was awesome! I really enjoyed his class and it was very fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: A veteran of the industry with abundant knowledge, paired with exceptional communication skills used to share that knowledge. Loved the class, wish I had more professors like this one.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Excellent professor who keeps things light while focusing on the important stuff. Very receptive to communication. Very test and quiz heavy. Not many assignments. Studying is a must. Great option for a professor if you need this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Simms is an amazing teacher and has an entertaining personality. Most of his assignments are drawn from lecture material so make sure you show up as much as you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Inspirational

reviews.comment: Was a pretty good teacher and organized. You don't need to buy the textbook. The class is mainly PowerPoints notes and random quizzes that are significant to your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Simms is probably one of my favorite professors in college so far. He really cares about his students but expects you to put in the effort. The class was test heavy and had pop quizzes often, but it was very doable. Make a point to talk to him (especially if you're struggling) and he will remember you. Show up and be ready to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took both COSC 253 and 254 with Simms and this guy is a total beast. I would take both classes with Prof. Simms 10 times if I had to. Tests can be tough but not terrible to succeed at. Quizzes are easy and what he uses to determine attendance. If you read ahead in the textbook, this class will be easy. Super nice guy, 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't let the rolling powerpoint tests scare you. If you have ever done OSHA or NCCER training then you will feel right at home. He does alot to help you out, like creating a fill in the blank review. Only 3-4 questions from each test come from the textbook so its not absolutely mandatory to pass, but keeping up with the readings will get you an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is a COVID-19 review. Before COVID-19, Simms was very clear about what he taught in the classroom and he was very entertaining which is always a plus. He cares about his students and he's straight forward. Take him and you'll learn so much about construction. When everything moved online, everything was simple and straightforward. Easy final.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I knew little to nothing about construction, but Simms is an amazing professor! He's really good at explaining concepts and is extremely knowledgeable about the subject. Don't be intimidated by the tests! Use quizlet to study the concepts and you should be fine. I got an A on the first test by studying a quizlet 2 weeks prior to the test!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took Simms for 253 and 254, he's a great professor, very helpful if you go to office hours. His lectures (for the most part) are great. reviews.comment: He cares about his students and wants to get to know you on a personal level and help out whenever he can. reviews.comment: Prof. Simms is my favorite professor so far. If you get the chance to take him, do not pass it up. The overall grade for the course was based on 4 tests and random pop quizzes. reviews.comment: Lance Simms is a solid guy. He knows his stuff, is very easy to get along with, has clear guidelines, and sincerely cares about his students! Overall, I highly recommend!

reviews.comment: His lectures are engaging and he's truly doing his best to get us to understand the concepts. He brings in examples of things we're talking about and he's always in his office.
